differences.resolution: All agree. The deciding fact is POL-NS-01(c): a continuous in-geofence dwell of free_wait_sec 180 (EV-TRIP-04053 platform_policy) from the first qualifying fix, elapsing before the 21:17:20 RIDER_NO_SHOW termination (limb (d)). Its only carrier is EV-GPS-04053, which observes the driver in the 50 m STANDARD radius only 21:13:50-21:15:00 and then has a 170 s gap (21:15:00-21:17:50) containing the cancellation; 140 s of the arrival-to-cancellation window is unobserved, so POL-NS-08(b) (gap > 120 s inside the waiting window) impairs it for policy purposes. No independent carrier: arrival_marker BUTTON so POL-NS-12 is out; the 21:16:30 call and the chat record no position. POL-NS-08 closing sentence + POL-NS-09(e) escalate; independently POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at 0.45 (0.60 once POL-NS-11 removes the rider_track factor), below 0.70 -> POL-NS-09(a). Key right.
All agree. ESCALATE is terminal and carries no money (POL-GEN-03, POL-NS-09).
All agree. POL-NS-07 cannot run because POL-NS-01 cannot be established; both readers note the counterfactual would be 0.8 x 4.50 = 3.60 (Decimal check: 3.600), which is the trap, not the answer.

All agree. POL-NS-05 not engaged (marker fix 21:14:00 is 8.7 m from the pin at 0 km/h; position-derived speed over the preceding 10 s 21.4 m = 7.7 km/h), so no false-arrival record; reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, so no mis-selected-code referral under POL-NS-01.

Readers add POL-NS-01 (both), POL-NS-11 and POL-GEN-03 (reader b). The key lists the three clauses that license and trigger the ESCALATE (POL-NS-08 closing sentence, POL-NS-09(e)/(a), POL-GEN-02(2)); each licenses ESCALATE per its licenses array, and none listed fails to apply. POL-NS-01 defines the deciding fact but licenses no ESCALATE and fixes no amount here; POL-NS-11 licenses nothing; POL-GEN-03 is the universal vocabulary clause the brief says not to lean on. The additions are harmless and their absence from the key is not an error. No change.

All agree. ESCALATE because the evidence cannot settle the deciding fact (driver position 21:15:00-21:17:20). The rider's 'cancelled almost immediately' is contradicted by EV-TRIP-04053 (200 s after the marker), but the escalation is evidential, so INDETERMINATE, not REVERSAL.

Checked every figure against the case file with check_set's haversine (R 6371.0088): first in-radius fix 21:13:50 at 24.9 m (acc 6.1, 8 km/h), 10 s before the 21:14:00 marker; 8 fixes 21:13:50-21:15:00 (70 s), 21:14:00-21:15:00 fixes 8.7-11.9 m at 0 km/h; gap 170 s 21:15:00-21:17:50; 21:15:00 to 21:17:20 = 140 s of 210 s unobserved; weight 0.6 x 0.75 = 0.45; fee 4.50 net / 6.61 gross REFUNDED (EV-FARE-04053); 3.60 = 0.8 x 4.50; call 21:16:30. Evidence ids EV-TRIP-04053, EV-GPS-04053, EV-FARE-04053 and clause ids POL-NS-01(c), POL-NS-08(b), POL-NS-09(a)/(e), POL-GEN-02(2), POL-NS-11, POL-NS-12 all exist and are used correctly. Length 1575 chars, ASCII. No factual error.

analysis: No substantive difference: both blind readers reach ESCALATE / null / null / no referrals / INDETERMINATE, matching the key; the only difference is extra harmless clauses in their governing lists. Independent check on the version-6 text. Scope: NO_SHOW_CHARGE, driver-filed (contests the 4.50 net fee after support refunded the 6.61 gross line), no flags. Figures from platform_policy: free_wait_sec 180, fee 4.50 net / 6.61 gross, arrival_marker BUTTON, zone STANDARD (radius 50 m, accuracy filter 25 m). POL-NS-01(a) arrived event 21:14:00 holds; (b)/POL-NS-02: 21:13:40 is 63.2 m (outside), 21:13:50 24.9 m and 21:14:00-21:15:00 seven fixes 8.7-11.9 m, all accuracy <= 8.1 m -> at least 3 consecutive qualifying fixes at/before the marker, (b) holds. POL-NS-05 not engaged (8.7 m, 0 km/h at the marker; arrival-event to fix skew 0 s). (c) is the deciding limb: 180 s from 21:13:50 elapses at 21:16:50 (21:17:00 from the marker), before the 21:17:20 termination, so the fee turns on whether the driver held the radius through the 170 s gap 21:15:00-21:17:50. The bracketing fixes (9.2 m and 21.9 m, 31 m apart) make presence likely but do not measure it; the NS-08 notes name a gap straddling the cancellation as the classic way a short dwell is made to look complete. POL-NS-08(b): the gap is 170 s long and 140 s of it lies inside the arrival-to-cancellation waiting window, so it exceeds 120 s on either measure; fewer-than-6-fixes limb not engaged (7-8 fixes). The trace is the sole carrier (BUTTON marker -> POL-NS-12 inapplicable; call and chat place nobody), so POL-NS-08's closing sentence and POL-NS-09(e) require ESCALATE. Robustness: even a reader who took 'waiting window' to mean only the 180 s free-wait period (in-window gap portion 110-120 s, not longer than 120 s) still escalates, because POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the sole carrier's weight, 0.45, or 0.60 after POL-NS-11 removes the PARTIAL_RECORD (rider_track) factor, below the 0.70 floor -> POL-NS-09(a). So no alternative answer is defensible and no case fix is needed. Rejected alternatives: DRIVER_COMPENSATION 3.60 (reads continuity across the impaired gap; the impaired trace cannot alone support a ruling against the rider, and the cap is below 0.70); NO_ACTION via POL-NS-06 on a 70 s observed dwell (rests on the same impaired trace against the driver; NS-02 notes treat a sparse trace as impaired, not proof of absence) or via POL-GEN-07 burden (GEN-07 applies only where no clause licenses an outcome, and NS-09 licenses ESCALATE). POL-NS-04 fails on (a) (rider's only message 21:12:30 precedes the window) and (b) (driver replied at 21:14:10 and called at 21:16:30); limb (c) undecidable under POL-NS-11. POL-NS-10 not applicable (driver cancellation). POL-NS-08(a),(c),(d) clean. POL-NS-09(c) 0+0; (d) driver 1/150, rider 0 -> not tripped. POL-NS-03 n/a (stationary fixes inside the radius). EV-ADVIS-04053-01 MISSING, relied on by nobody. Key ground truth stands unchanged.
